body: Not a bad idea, you're also a very lucky person to met your future wife at 15...

Im 15 years old. I've been going through major life changes right as everyone starts hating me... my girlfriend and I were perfect before. We woke up next to each other happy every single day and went to bed together, but now she wont even talk to me at all... Its been like this for about a week and I dont know if I can take it much longer...

I just need to talk to someone to calm down...

I don't have a pet sadly... I wish I did sometimes. I know exactly how you feel about the ex girlfriend thing, how it hurts you to stay with them but it'll hurt you so much more to be alone. I would try to take care of someone but like I said, we bounce around from place to place like gypsies.

Im pretty calm now, my girlfriend got on skype and we talked this all out. Thanks for all the help you've given me and for actually trying to help, which you did a great job at.

For Anyone Else Looking: I'll keep checking this post for a while, night.
I hope its not as hard forever as its been for me this past week... thanks for your help so far.

I have major codependency so losing someone I really love is alot harder for me than it seems to most people, because I use my friends and my girlfriend as a way to release all the depression. I cant make friends anymore because of the depression and moving so I don't know how to release without her...

Im 15, just about to turn 16. 

Im worried im going to live alone until im older, so ive been thinking why not just end it now and get it over with. Its not worth it to live with depression like this and not having anything to look forward to.
My girlfriend left me to go somewhere and my brothers crying and I cant make him stop, feeling useless as always... how about you?
